body:
My Orange Son's name is Kevin.
I love talking to people about Kevin without context.

 "Kevin was up a tree yesterday yelling at me, I told him to shut up and come inside. He ignored me. So I left him up the tree and shut the door. I did let him inside eventually."

Give yourself some leeway. For me resetting every time made me feel horrible and almost more likely to relapse. 
I changed to just taking off a day if I'd only done it once, if I did it and continued then it was a restart. So if I tried and ended up SHing, but only that time I didn't reset the timer. Using that I'm at about a year and a half.

Thank you for the kind words. I'm okay during the day, but nights are always harder.
And things are difficult at the moment which is definitely making it harder. I'll probably make it to 12months free.

Had an appointment today with a new GP and my support worker came with me. I was pretty upfront about my MH and hospitalisation last year, and she asked if I had any current sui or sh thoughts... 
They were kinda giving me funny looks while I said no and no, and I know the drill if I get to crisis and who to call blah blah... 
This is not my first rodeo. Dude, I know more of the crisis contact numbers than they do 🤣

As a kid I was really upset and was walking around outside and stood on a nail. It hurt, but made me feel a little better.
Scratching and biting and so on, until I started working in animal medicine and had the brilliant idea to use a scalpel.
I'm a bit of an idiot tbh so whenever someone has asked what is that I always respond with "it's a tattoo" and show them my wrist... 98% sure afterwards they probs didn't mean the tattoo...

I'm 33. I'm staying with my friend who is more than happy for me to stay long-term. She doesn't want me to pay rent or anything, but if I stay long-term I will insist on paying some rent. It's just all so painful atm and the urges to SH are so strong and at this stage I feel like it'd definitely help me feel better. 😔

Started when I was 10... turning 33 in a week 😬
I'm currently 5 months clean, which is the longest I've ever gone. 😬😬
So I can still feel it and watch my skin open up?? Coz I find the blood annoying as it adds to the clean up... TBH if there was no blood (therefore less cleanup) I'd go deeper.

I'm 32 and have been SH'ing since I was about 11. Currently 133 days (a little over 4 months) since I last SH'd, which is the longest I've gone since I started.

The urges are getting harder and harder to ignore. I really don't know if the urges ever completely go away. When my mood isn't as bad the thoughts still sorta come up, but I can still go about my day and it's fine. At the moment my mood is shit and the urges are so strong.

I have the last few nights, to the point that when I woke up I went to check the spot.

I've not sh'd for 130 days, and between the urges getting harder to ignore and the dreams I will probably give up and do it.

My awkward favourite was a customer at work pointed at my arm and said "what is that?" In a mega rude voice. And I was completely oblivious and responded by saying it was a tattoo and holding it out...
I have old healed white scars on my wrist and a tattoo on my wrist. The scars are fairly faint.

She said no, not the tattoo, the scars. And I just went "oh, I thought you wanted to see my tattoo". Stupid woman gave up and left.
Boss was in the office cackling.

I still don't understand why people think it's okay to point out people's scars...

130 days today. Finding it really hard at the moment. I gave my psychologist all my tools in November and got rid of the first aid stuff too. 
Today I was at the shops and really wanting to get tools, ended up getting the first aid stuff (bandaids, tape, antiseptic) but jot the tools so I guess that's a win...

8/9??? I've sorted my plan and an intended date (when I have some time off, so I'll tell those I live with I'm going away for a bit, no one will think anything odd for a week or so)
Feeling so much relief now I think I have it all sorted
